scope: test/integration/cert-*.mjs; direct requested patterns and expanded URL, fetch, registry and command references

entries.classification: CLI child-process catalog fetches use explicit test-only preloads for exactly two immutable URLs; every other request passes through. Regression children block original outbound fetch and assert golden bytes and refusal. PR API fixtures use loopback HTTP.

Large-plan output regressions route the actual planner's GitHub API reads to a case-owned loopback HTTP server with empty fixture credentials. The http://fixture URL is only a local URL-parser base; embedded and partial verdict cases use local Node stdout, not network requests. No remote host is dialed.

The raw URL is asserted against an injected fetcher returning local Response bytes; unavailable, HTTP and oversized cases use injected responses, not remote requests. Artifact URLs are provenance data.
Artifact download tests replace and restore globalThis.fetch with deterministic ZIP responses. GitHub run URLs are provenance data, not dialed hosts.
CLI artifact readers use GITHUB_API_URL pointing to case-owned loopback servers and empty fixture credentials; GitHub URLs identify artifacts in JSON, not outbound requests.
Fetch references inspect workflow YAML and execute credential-free git fetch against a case-owned local repository; checkout and npm ci text is asserted, not executed remotely by these tests.
Registry and GitHub provenance values are local JSON evidence fixtures. No registry.npmjs.org or api.github.com request is present.
Expanded grep hits identify local curlwright binaries, synthetic npm versions, installed corpus bytes and fake harness-port subprocesses; no external fetch or https.get call is present.

remaining: No direct api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org or https.get calls found. Installation and Cargo dependency setup occur before this suite and are not claimed offline. Blocking Node fetch is an execution cross-check, not a native-process network attestation. Production readers are unchanged.
